detail_totals.schedule: Schedule of Net Patient Service Revenue

notes: Entirely business-type hospital (GAAP); governmental fields null. Receipts = operating revenue plus nonoperating revenue (noncapital grants and investment income); disbursements = operating expenses plus interest expense. No single printed total, so reported_totals are computed. Capital Grants and Contributions 391,218 (below the line) recorded as business_type.other_financing; net position 38,113,477 + 5,196,256 + 391,218 = 43,700,951. Proprietary data from Statement of Cash Flows p4; p5 (added by the v8 re-trim) is its reconciliation of operating income to net cash from operating activities (net cash from operating 3,621,127 ties) and adds no new figures. The statement's line 'Revenue in Excess of Expenses Before Capital Grants and Contributions' is 5,196,256. Detail: net patient revenue schedule uses the 2025 Total column (gross 54,295,591 less deductions 11,292,428); departmental expense schedule (excludes depreciation 1,892,753; its Supplies and Other column includes employee benefits, supplies, services, etc.) is not double counting since detail is separate from receipts/disbursements. Read pages 1-7 of 7.
